title: HTMXUI Framework Attribute & Grammar Specification
description: Formal machine-readable grammar, attribute rules, element targets, and scope definitions for HTMXUI.

bolt.description: Signal-based fine-grained reactive state engine & 2D sparse matrix

flash.description: In-memory typo-tolerant fuzzy search, multi-column filter & ColumnStore engine

form.description: Declarative validation state machine, cell transactions & optimistic UI engine

a11y.description: WAI-ARIA focus trap, roving tabindex & 2D matrix navigation engine

virtual.description: 1D and 2D bi-directional viewport virtualization engine (100k+ rows)

grid.description: Enterprise Data Grid with column resize, reorder, and CSV export

calc.description: Zero-dependency reactive formula engine with topological sorting DAG

offline.description: IndexedDB offline cache & 409 conflict resolution engine

devtools.description: In-browser telemetry profiler, signal visualizer & state inspector

hx-state.description: Declares local reactive component state context.

hx-computed.example: hx-computed="{ total: price * qty, isValid: count > 0 }"

hx-effect.description: Runs a side effect function whenever tracked signal dependencies mutate.

hx-model.description: Two-way data binding for form controls.

hx-text.description: Binds element innerText to a reactive expression.

hx-html.description: Binds element innerHTML to a reactive expression.
hx-html.securityWarning: Ensure content is sanitized against XSS.

hx-show.description: Toggles element visibility using CSS display property with transition hooks.

hx-if.description: Structural conditional mounting/unmounting of DOM elements.

hx-for.description: Structural list loop rendering on template elements.
hx-for.syntax: item in items | (item, index) in items

hx-class.description: Conditionally applies CSS classes from an object map or string expression.

hx-style.description: Dynamically sets inline CSS styles from an object map.

hx-cell.description: Binds DOM element directly to atomic 2D sparse matrix coordinates with O(1) fine-grained signal reactivity.

hx-stream-batch.description: Enables 60fps RAF stream throttle and delta micro-batching for incoming SSE and WebSocket updates.

hx-virtual-2d.description: Enables bi-directional (X + Y) matrix viewport virtualization with pinned column support.

hx-matrix-nav.description: Enables Excel-grade 2D roving tabindex, Shift+Arrow range selection, and ARIA grid keyboard navigation.

hx-pinned-left.description: Number of columns pinned sticky to the left viewport boundary in 2D virtualized grid.

hx-pinned-right.description: Number of columns pinned sticky to the right viewport boundary in 2D virtualized grid.

hx-on.description: Attaches event listeners with modifiers. Short syntax: @event

hx-action.description: Executes expression on element click with audio/motion feedback.

hx-validate.description: Pipes validation rules on inputs (required, email, min:N, max:N, numeric, match:fieldName).

hx-error-for.description: Renders active validation error string for specified form control.

hx-wizard.description: Enables multi-step wizard state machine with step validation gates.

hx-step.description: Declares wizard step index inside an hx-wizard form.

hx-optimistic.description: Enables optimistic UI swaps with automatic rollback on 4xx/5xx network errors.

hx-virtual.description: Recycles DOM elements for 100k+ row datasets with top/bottom spacers.

hx-flash-search.description: Binds instant 0ms client-side fuzzy search input to in-memory database.

hx-flash-filter.description: Binds multi-column filter control to in-memory database.

hx-flash-sort.description: Binds sort column header to in-memory database.

hx-vibe-flip.description: Enables 60fps First-Last-Invert-Play (FLIP) layout animations on reordering.

hx-vibe-card.description: Enables interactive 3D perspective tilt following mouse movement.

hx-vlt-glare.description: Adds holographic specular sheen glare overlay on 3D cards.

hx-vibe-magnetic.description: Enables elastic magnetic snapping to cursor pointer.

hx-vibe-split.description: Kinetic typography engine splitting text into staggered 3D span reveals.

hx-vpx-blast.description: Explosive radial shockwave dispersing surrounding elements with physics impulses.

hx-tick.description: Evaluates a reactive expression on every frame of the 120 FPS game loop ticker.

hx-vibe-stagger.description: Staggers animation delay across children elements.

hx-trap-focus.description: WAI-ARIA compliant modal focus trapping for dialogs and sheets.

scaleui.description: Enables fluid responsive component resizing testing.

scopeVariables.description: Variables and HyperFX action helpers accessible inside expressions and event actions

$refs.description: Dictionary of elements tagged with hx-ref="name"

$event.description: The native DOM event in actions

$form.description: Form state object: { valid, dirty, touched, errors }

$blast.description: HyperFX: Triggers radial explosive shockwave ($blast({ radius: 300, force: 50 }))

$exportCSV.description: HyperFX: Triggers instant client-side CSV download ($exportCSV('#grid', 'data.csv'))

errorCatalog.HTMXUI-BOLT-001: Invalid JSON/JS syntax in hx-state or <script type="application/json" hx-state>
errorCatalog.HTMXUI-BOLT-002: Circular dependency detected in hx-computed property
errorCatalog.HTMXUI-BOLT-003: Invalid hx-for expression syntax. Expected 'item in list' or '(item, index) in list'
errorCatalog.HTMXUI-BOLT-004: Referenced undefined property or store in expression
errorCatalog.HTMXUI-BOLT-005: Possible typo in attribute name (autocorrect suggestion provided)
errorCatalog.HTMXUI-FLASH-001: Flash database queried before initialization or fetch error
errorCatalog.HTMXUI-CALC-001: Formula syntax error in hx-calc expression
errorCatalog.HTMXUI-CALC-002: Circular reference (#CYCLE!) in spreadsheet formula DAG
